model.name: Boots may not name a sprint/version diverging from HEAD, and carry no active-state (currency guard + state-removal cure)
model.description: A rewound agent re-derives its world from its boot.md ACTIVE section; when that section carries STALE state it inherits a dead world = the GHOST-CONTEXT ROOT (measured a7ac8892: expert boots v0.8.61 ~62 versions stale, req S31, planner v0.7.65/S30-S31, while HEAD is S40/v0.8.123; 9 agents booted off these today). Two layers: (Layer 1, interim) a currency guard - for every boot naming a sprint/version in an active-state position, boot.named==gitHEAD.derived else RED, folded into the boot-essence lint via the SAME structuralDiscover (single-source), discovered BY GLOB fleet-wide with a divergence check, fail-closed on unparseable, lessons-headings exempt, own stub-must-fail; (Layer 2, the cure) state-removal - boots become timeless rules + identity + an anchor POINTER to context.md with ZERO state, worded so the guard never ENTRENCHES state-bearing boots as acceptable (WARN now, RED per-file as each cure lands).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The REAL target (deeper assertion) is that a boot carries NO active-state: timeless rules + identity + an ANCHOR POINTER to context.md (R113 shape). ★ WHAT IS STATE — the FACT-vs-FINDER test (architect D3): a line asserting a ROTTING FACT ABOUT THE WORLD => STRIP; a HOW-TO-FIND pointer/rule/identity => KEEP. Enumerated subtle classes the sprint/version check misses: transient-git-ref (stash@{0}), infra-path-or-hash (NODE18 vscode-server bin hash, port), pane->role roster — WITH a divergence/completeness check (a fact-shaped line in no enumerated class => triage-flag, not silent-pass; enumerate-not-universal). ★ WHOSE STATE COUNTS — honest scope (PO false-UNSATISFACTION ruling; same OWNED/EXCLUDED/UNCLASSIFIED shape as named-exclusion ed9eadecb), 3 clauses: (a) COVERAGE UNIVERSAL — the guard DISCOVERS + evaluates EVERY boot fleet-wide; (b) SATISFACTION OWNED — this AC's satisfaction is judged ONLY over boots WE own (robbin-*); a robbin boot carrying active-state => UNMET; (c) EXCLUSION EXPLICIT + TIME-BOXED — other-team boots (oosh-trio, another PO's files we may not edit) are NAMED-EXCLUDED + WARN-LOUD (never silently dropped) + NOT counted against our satisfaction, and the exclusion CLOSES on an oosh-PO-coordination clock (contextAnchorCurrencyDebt-style), NEVER a permanent silent carve-out; and an exclusion whose named boot no longer exists (a DEAD exemption) => RED, since a stale exemption is itself the rot it was meant to bound (aligns 1:1 with exclusion mechanism ed9eadecb: EXCLUDED carries reason + TIME-BOX + must resolve). This prevents FALSE-UNSATISFACTION (an AC permanently unmet through no fault of ours = the mirror of the false-satisfaction this family kills), while NOT entrenching state-bearing robbin boots as acceptable. ★ 3-BUCKET SEMANTICS (architect, matches shipped guard + design 6e626ed98 — post-satisfaction wording alignment to the VERIFIED behaviour, not a requirement change): OWNED = timeless, RED IFF state-bearing. EXCLUDED = named-or-predicate not-ours, WARN-loud, NEVER RED. UNCLASSIFIED = held to the OWNED standard (RED IFF state-bearing; a TIMELESS unclassified boot PASSES) + surfaced-for-triage. It is NOT unclassified=RED-by-default. ★ PO LEGITIMACY TEST (why this post-satisfaction reword is legitimate, NOT satisfy-first-then-reword-to-fit): (a) it aligns the AC DESCRIPTION to the VERIFIED shipped behaviour; (b) the BAR WAS NOT LOWERED — auto-RED-on-unclassified was NEVER the intent; (c) THE TEST: was the original wording the INTENDED BAR we then softened, or a WRONG DESCRIPTION of an intent that never changed? => the LATTER — the architect corrected its OWN design doc (6e626ed98, verified: 'RED iff state-bearing, not auto-RED') for the SAME error AFTER the PO ruled the implementation right + prose wrong; the shipped 3-bucket behaviour is what was built, verified + satisfied; evidence UNCHANGED. A description correction, not a bar relaxation.
